subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should TTS keep the documented provider fallback chain by default, or should a configured `messages.tts.provider` become sticky enough to fail instead of playing another provider after the primary provider fails or is skipped?
rationale: Current code, docs, tests, and the latest release preserve provider fallback, while the reporter expected configured ElevenLabs audio rather than OpenAI fallback; changing that behavior is compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Adopt sticky configured provider
options.body: Change configured-provider TTS to fail visibly instead of falling back unless the user explicitly opts into fallback behavior, updating docs and tests accordingly.

options.title: Preserve fallback, improve diagnostics
options.body: Keep the current fallback chain as the default and treat this issue as a request for clearer diagnostics or user education around why ElevenLabs failed or was skipped.

options.title: Add an explicit fallback policy knob
options.body: Keep existing default behavior for compatibility and add a documented opt-in strict/sticky mode for users who never want another provider voice.

recommendation.title: Adopt sticky configured provider
recommendation.body: Change configured-provider TTS to fail visibly instead of falling back unless the user explicitly opts into fallback behavior, updating docs and tests accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged diagnostics and fallback-observability work that defines the current partial-fix boundary for this cluster.
